configDirInside: This is Gately's configuration directory or lies inside it ({dir}). It holds the sign-in keys and cannot be used; choose another directory.
configDirContains: This directory contains Gately's configuration directory ({dir}). It can be used as usual and the configuration directory is hidden automatically: it is not listed, cannot be read or written, and the directories above it cannot be renamed or deleted.
configDirWhole: This directory overlaps Gately's configuration directory ({dir}). File Browser reads directories directly as an external program and cannot hide the configuration directory, so choose a directory that does not contain it.
name: Name
unexpectedResponse: The server returned an unexpected response. Reload the page; if a security entrance is set, open it again through the entrance address
refreshFailed: Refresh failed: {error}. Showing the data from the last successful load.
networkError: Cannot reach Gately. Check your network connection or make sure the service is still running
docsTitle: Open the docs for this page in a new window
aiTranslated: The interface is translated with AI and may contain inaccuracies. Help improve it on GitHub.
copyHint: Creating a new item based on "{name}". Saving adds a new item and leaves the original unchanged.
copyHintSecrets: Passwords, tokens and other secrets you leave unchanged are taken from the original.
